items.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: I have a band in LA called The Elders. You’ll be hearing about this band. Tootie Heath is in it, Herman Riley who works with Jimmy Smith at the moment, and Phil Wright, pianist.

ctx.x: Yeah. I have a band in LA called The Elders. You’ll be hearing about this band. Tootie Heath is in it, Herman Riley who works with Jimmy Smith at the moment, and Phil Wright, pianist. Herman plays reeds and Phil Wright, pianist, he’s an arranger and a composer and vocalist and all that stuff. We have a great little band in LA. You’ll be hearing about it.
